name: Quagmire
summary: In central Dustwallow Marsh, the Quagmire is a perilous stretch of fen. Brackenwall Village lies north and the Dragonmurk south. Waterlogged flats, hostile beasts, and ravenous oozes make crossing it dangerous.

sections.title: Heart of the Fen
sections.body: The Quagmire runs from Lost Point in the west to Dustwallow Bay in the east, through the marsh’s wild heart. Solid ground can give way to murky water and clinging mud without warning. Crocolisks wait beneath the scum, aggressive spiders nest in dead brush, and strange oozes seep through the muck.

sections.title: Encroaching Clashes
sections.body: The Quagmire lies where sentient powers contest the swamp, an unpredictable crossing in their struggles. Tabetha's Farm stands in the bog as a lonely refuge. There, practitioners seek wisdom from a hermit amid the swamp’s dangers.

faq.answer: The Quagmire covers central Dustwallow Marsh, from Lost Point in the west to Dustwallow Bay in the east. Brackenwall Village lies north, while the land descends into the Dragonmurk to the south.

angles.text: Deep in the fen, Tabetha's Farm draws aspiring mages seeking esoteric training beyond the Kirin Tor's scrutiny.
